title: Baked Mediterranean Vegetables with Feta and Couscous
description: A tray of Mediterranean vegetables roasted with garlic and herbs, topped with feta cheese and served over couscous.
ingredients: 2 red peppers, deseeded and roughly chopped
large handful of basil or parsley leaves
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan (425°F), Gas Mark 7.
In a large roasting tin, mix together the onions, courgettes, peppers, tomatoes, aubergine and garlic. Drizzle over the olive oil and balsamic vinegar, add the oregano and thyme, season and mix well.
Roast in the oven for 35 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Remove from the oven, scatter the feta over the vegetables and return to the oven for 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, place the couscous in a bowl, pour over the boiling water, cover with a plate and leave for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Serve the roasted vegetables and feta on top of the couscous, scattered with herbs.
notes: This is wonderful served with a drizzle of tahini. You can also add olives or sun-dried tomatoes to the vegetable mix.
